meta.name: Call of Life — Facing the Mass Extinction
meta.description: All over the world, species are going extinct at an extraordinary rate–currently around 250 per day–a scale never before seen.Call of Lifeinvestigates the growing threat to Earths life support systems from this unprecedented loss of biodiversity by exploring the causes, scope, and potential effects of this mass extinction. The film also looks beyond the immediate causes of the crisis to consider how our cultural and economic systems, along with deep-seated psychological and behavioral patterns, have allowed this situation to develop and be reinforced, and even determine our response to it.Call of Lifetells the story of a crisis not only of nature, but also of human nature; a crisis more threatening than anything human beings have ever faced…
